name: Progeni Bench
shortDescription: 30 private browser file, craft, media, and spreadsheet utilities running 100% locally with zero server uploads.
description: Progeni Bench is a private, client-side toolkit designed for creators, crafters, and everyday desk workers. It features 30 focused utilities — including Avery label generators, sticker sheet makers, t-shirt mirror tools, cross-stitch chart creators, SRT subtitle speed auditors, contact CSV deduplication, and photo croppers. Every tool processes your files directly in browser memory using Web Workers, Canvas, and HTML5 APIs without sending a single byte to an external server.
capabilities: Sticker Sheet Maker — printable grids, kiss-cut lines, PNG / PDF / SVG export
Avery 5160 / Label Maker — 5160, 5163, 5167, L7160 and custom label sheets
T-Shirt Print Mirror — flip art for heat-transfer paper
Iron-on Transfer Sheet Maker — US Letter and A4 layouts at 300 DPI
Print Layout Optimizer — pack up to 40 photos onto a sheet
Photo Print Border Calculator — exact mat borders for common frame sizes
Cross-Stitch Pattern Maker — photo to chart with DMC floss colours
Diamond Painting Pattern Maker — symbol charts with drill counts and canvas plan
Embroidery Pattern Simplifier — reduce artwork to a simple thread palette
Video Safe-Zone Checker — TikTok, Reels and Shorts overlay previews
Video Thumbnail Contact Sheet — 4–48 timestamped frames in one PNG
Chapter Timestamp Formatter — YouTube and podcast chapter timestamps
Podcast Silence Map — detect dead air and export gap lists
Subtitle Reading-Speed Checker — CPS, duration and line-length audit for SRT
Subtitle Line-Break Fixer — rewrap long subtitle lines to your limits
Contact CSV Deduplicator — merge duplicate CRM contacts by email or phone
CSV Column Splitter — split names and addresses without Excel
CSV Date Normalizer — standardize dates to US, ISO or European format
vCard (VCF) Split & Merge — combine and inspect contact files
Chrome Bookmark Cleaner — strip duplicate bookmarks and dead folders
Bookmark to Reading List — turn bookmark HTML into an offline reading list
SVG Cleanup & Minifier — strip metadata and shrink SVG files
iCal Calendar Deduplicator — find repeated VEVENT entries in .ics exports
Timetable to Calendar — turn a class timetable CSV into recurring events
Wallpaper Photo Cropper — crop to phone, tablet and desktop presets
Panorama Carousel Splitter — slice wide photos into Instagram tiles
Photo Duplicate Finder — find exact and near-duplicate photos
Photo Best-Shot Finder — rank burst photos by sharpness and exposure
Photo Timeline Builder — build a chronological album from EXIF dates
Family Photo Date Organizer — sort photos into a date tree and export a rename plan

name: WaKit (WhatsSwift)
shortDescription: Free client-side WhatsApp utilities: 30s status video splitter, direct unsaved chat, QR code generator, and 16MB audio compressor.
description: WaKit (also known as WhatsSwift) provides high-performance WhatsApp productivity tools powered by WebAssembly. Users can split long videos into precise 30-second status clips using lossless FFmpeg stream copy, open direct chats with international phone numbers without saving contacts, generate scan-to-chat QR codes, and transcode audio recordings under WhatsApp's 16MB attachment ceiling. All computations run in the client sandbox with zero telemetry.
capabilities: 30-Second Status Video Splitter (Lossless WebAssembly)
Direct WhatsApp Chat Without Saving Numbers
Custom Scan-to-Chat & Wi-Fi QR Code Generator
Audio Compressor for 16MB WhatsApp Limit
Zero Server Uploads & Zero Storage
No Signup or Account Required
